12. What are the domains in the standardized language for 
nutrition intervention?
•
Food and/or Nutrient Delivery (ND): meals, snacks, 
enteral/parenteral feeding, supplements, assistance,
environment, and medication management
•
Nutrition Education (E): impart knowledge to help
patients/clients to voluntarily manage/modify food 
choices and eating behavior to maintain and improve 
health
•
Nutrition Counseling (C): collaborative, supportive
process that fosters responsibility for self-care to treat an 
existing condition and promote health
•
Coordination of Nutrition Care (RC): consulta-
tion with, referral to, or coordination of nutrition care 
with other health care providers that assists in treating 
nutrition-related problems
